values.heading: Profile
values.summary: Software engineer building accessible web applications and reliable data services. Combines TypeScript and Python development with practical testing, clear documentation, and close collaboration with product and operations teams.

entries.title: Software Engineer
accomplishments: Built a React scheduling interface used by 45 field coordinators to assign maintenance visits and resolve conflicts before dispatch.
Designed typed API contracts and PostgreSQL migrations for work orders, with audit history and role-based access checks across customer accounts.
Reduced the nightly import from 38 minutes to 11 minutes by batching database writes and adding resumable processing for incomplete files.

entries.title: Engineering Intern
accomplishments: Implemented an accessible appointment form with keyboard navigation, inline validation, and clear confirmation messages for returning clients.
Added integration tests for availability rules and documented the handoff process so staff could diagnose common booking failures.
Created an offline trip planner that keeps route notes and equipment lists available without a network connection.
Implemented conflict-aware synchronization and tested reconnection behavior using interrupted requests and concurrent edits.
Built an inventory service for a fictional food pantry, including expiration tracking, CSV imports, and weekly stock summaries.

values.heading: Profile
values.summary: Software engineer with eight years of experience building operational software, data integrations, and internal developer tools. Works across product interfaces and backend services, with a focus on reliable delivery, understandable systems, and useful observability. Leads technical planning while remaining hands-on with implementation, testing, and production support.

entries.title: Senior Software Engineer
accomplishments: Led the design and delivery of a shipment exception workspace that brings carrier events, customer notes, and resolution history into a single accessible interface for 120 operations specialists.
Replaced a nightly reconciliation job with an event-driven pipeline that validates incoming records, retries transient failures, and routes ambiguous matches to an operator review queue.
Designed tenant-scoped authorization for shared services and added integration coverage for account boundaries, historical records, and delegated support access.
Reduced median investigation time from 22 minutes to 9 minutes by linking application traces to the exact shipment event and providing actionable error messages in the support console.
Established a release checklist covering database compatibility, staged rollouts, rollback evidence, and customer-facing acceptance; supported twelve releases without a data migration incident.
Mentored three engineers through design reviews and paired debugging sessions, and wrote maintenance guides for the import pipeline, authorization model, and on-call escalation process.

entries.title: Software Engineer
accomplishments: Built a public service directory with React and a typed search API, including accessible filtering, clear eligibility summaries, and an editorial workflow for partner organizations.
Implemented versioned data imports from municipal spreadsheets, preserving the original files and surfacing field-level validation errors before records became visible to residents.
Improved query performance by examining execution plans, adding focused indexes, and replacing repeated lookups with bounded joins; reduced the slowest directory queries by 65 percent.
Worked with program coordinators to translate policy changes into testable rules, including effective dates, exceptions, and clear explanations when an application required manual review.
Added browser tests for keyboard-only navigation and common form errors, and repaired focus management across dialogs used by screen-reader users.

entries.title: Junior Software Engineer
accomplishments: Delivered customer account pages and administrative tools for a regional equipment supplier using JavaScript, Python, and PostgreSQL.
Implemented server-side validation and transaction boundaries for order adjustments, preventing partial updates when inventory or payment checks failed.
Created repeatable development fixtures and documented local setup, allowing new contributors to run the application and reproduce reported defects in their first week.
Designed an incident coordination prototype that keeps a shared timeline, ownership decisions, and investigation notes synchronized across browser sessions.
Separated durable incident records from presence updates and tested reconnects, duplicate events, and concurrent changes with deterministic integration fixtures.
Published a technical walkthrough explaining the consistency model, failure recovery, and limits of the prototype using a fully fictional incident dataset.
Built a document import tool that verifies file checksums, records extraction provenance, and exports searchable metadata without modifying original source files.
Added resumable batch processing and a review report for malformed documents, missing metadata, and conflicting identifiers; tested recovery from interrupted writes.
Created small examples that demonstrate secure account isolation, optimistic concurrency, and idempotent commands with readable failure cases and focused tests.
Ran four peer workshops and revised the exercises from participant feedback, emphasizing how to choose simpler designs and identify assumptions that need validation.

details: Capstone: accessible scheduling tools for community organizations.
Completed an applied program covering replication, fault recovery, and service observability.
